BBMH Hospital has had a good reputation in terms of clinical skills and dedication to patients over the years. Doctors were trusted. Services were still growing. The number of patients visiting improved gradually.

However, internal processes could not keep up with the growth of the hospital.

At the backstage, administrative teams were pressurized. The physicians were taking more time to go through procedures than attending to patients. Data was in too many locations, and daily work did not have to be done.

solution_text: Enter Healthray HMS. BBMH Hospital decided to move forward after carefully evaluating multiple options. Why? Because Healthray was not just another software provider – it addressed the core operational challenges the hospital was facing.

metrics_2_text: fewer manual entry and reporting errors
intro_content:
Jeevan Rekha Hospital is a well established hospital in Raiganj, West Bengal, and it provides various services to patients including outpatient, inpatient, and diagnostic services. The diagnostic lab that is located within the hospital is essential in the day to day clinical decision making process where it assists the physicians to receive the right report at the right time.

The diagnostic lab became one of the busiest departments in the hospital as the number of patients continued to rise. Doctors were relying on quick turnaround times and patients were not willing to see repeat follow ups and quick results.

The lab team was competent and experienced clinically.

In practice, however, the system upon which they had been based had come to a strangle.
What had proved to be adequate with lower sample volumes was no more.
challange_text: The issues in the laboratory of Jeevan Rekha Hospital were not related to the lack of experience. They were a product of manual processes that were unable to keep pace with the demand.
challanges_0_text: The information related to the sample was entered manually. Records were duplicated between systems and registers. Monitoring of sample status was through verbal communication and it was confusing and delayed.
challanges_1_text: The entry and verification of test results were done manually. Technicians wasted their time typing, verifying numbers and fixing preventable errors. Delays in reports were even brought about by simple mistakes.
challanges_2_text: Sample volumes, pending tests and report status were not shown in real time. The process of planning workloads and determining delays had to be followed at all times.
challanges_3_title: Growing Pressure on Doctors and Patients
challanges_3_text: Late reporting affected clinical decisions and patient waiting times were long. Physicians were required to make follow-ups regularly, and patients took unnecessary time.
solution_text: The hospital determined that they would adopt the Healthray Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) after considering their possibilities.  The management at the hospital understood that it would simply add more employees to the current system which would not address the actual issue. They required a system-based, scaled-up method.

post.post_content: How Jabalpur hospitals leveraged Healthray to centralize patient records, reduce manual tasks, and deliver faster, data-driven medical care.
post.post_title: Healthray's Impact on Patient Care at Jabalpur Hospital

text_block_0_text: Jabalpur is a well-known multi-specialty healthcare center that delivers quality care to thousands of people living in central India. Jabalpur hospitals face numerous operational challenges due to antiquated digital systems, despite their high patient volume and strong clinical expertise. Old server-based Hospital Information Management System (HIMS) provided them limited accessibility. Doctors and medical staff members face challenges with patient data access outside the premises. This makes the coordination among departments slow and inefficient.Also, they lack integration with national healthcare initiatives like Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM). Due to this, data were scattered in different departments, which negatively impacts the interoperability and efficiency. Hospital administration has come to the conclusion that modernizing technology is essential to the healthcare system. Their objective was to put in place a fully integrated, AI-driven healthcare platform that unified all departments into a single system, enhanced accessibility, and complied with regulatory requirements.
text_block_1_text: After considering several options available on the market, Jabalpur hospitals have decided on Healthray because it is a complete and scalable solution. Healthray's web-based architecture has eliminated the need for on-premise servers and provides secure cloud access from anywhere. Healthray's integration-ready design connects multiple departments, such as OPD, IPD, Billing, Pharmacy and Lab modules, into a single ecosystem. ABDM compliance provides future-ready assurance and interoperability with national healthcare registries. The Healthray interface is simple and adaptable, which helps doctors easily handle ePrescription, OPD/IPD analysis, and lab management.
quote_text: Healthray has given us complete patient visibility; every work operation from diagnosis to discharge can now be accessed in just one single click. We no longer waste time on searching records…
result_text: Healthray's self-registration and online appointment booking features have completely transformed the front desk operation of Jabalpur hospitals. The Healthray application has minimized manual check-in efforts and significantly reduced the patient wait time. Now, patients can easily book their appointments, which expedites the check-in process. This minimized the staff workload and elevated efficacy in the system. As a result, hospitals have decreased their staff members without compromising the service quality.

Pharmacy workflows have become efficient with ePrescription sync and automated billing modules. Billing and OPD module integrations provide administrators with real-time occupancy, resource use and finance reports. This seamless integration makes the discharge process faster, reduces manual paperwork and improves communication among various departments.

text_block_3_text: One of the most significant turning points in Jabalpur hospitals' digital transformation journey is the integration of Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM). The medical operation that seemed complicated previously has become smooth and efficient with Healthray smart integration tools.The administrator says, “In the traditional system, it was challenging for departments and external networks to manage patient data. With the ABDM-linked Health ID, all departments are securely connected and accessible.”After this integration, Hospitals has acheived true continuity of care. Doctors can instantly access the patient history and can make smarter and more concrete decisions.

First, we began with a thorough assessment phase in which Healthray implementation specialists collaborated closely with clinical or administrative teams to further analyze their workflows and difficulties. Hospital legacy data got carefully migrated to the Healthray secure cloud system, ensuring a smooth transition from server-based setups to secure web servers.Administrators say, “Training sessions have boosted the confidence of medical staff; now every department can easily manage digital modules.”The combination of on-site workshops and virtual training has made doctors, nurses, and technicians proficient in managing appointments, prescriptions, reports and billing. With Healthray implementation, Jabalpur hospital staff has become truly tech-enabled and patient-focused.

post.post_content: Lilavati Hospital is transforming its healthcare operations by collaborating with Healthray, a comprehensive digital platform that eliminates major inefficiencies and elevates the patient experience.
post.post_title: Lilavati Hospital’s Path to Modern Healthcare: Leveraging Healthray for Operational Success

text_block_0_text: Lilavati Hospital is a renowned medical facility in Ahmedabad that offers top-notch care to thousands of patients. Despite holding a strong clinical reputation, Lilavati Hospital faces numerous challenges that restrict scalability and workflow efficiency. Physicians had to spend a lot of time writing patient records by hand, which prolonged consultations and wait times. High dependency on offline channels hampers the patient reach and follow-ups were not effective. No-shows were frequent due to the lack of automation in patient communication and appointment reminders. Manual registration and billing create chaos at front desks.Also, slow pharmacy and lab department communication impacts patient satisfaction at Lilavati Hospital. Patient needed to visit hospitals to check on reports and prescriptions. Hospital administration has come to the conclusion that modernizing technology is essential to the healthcare system. Their objective was to put in place a fully integrated, AI-driven healthcare platform that centralizes all the patient data, minimizes manual errors and provides real-time insights to doctors.
text_block_1_text: Faced with growing inefficiencies across its medical and administrative operations, Lilavati Hospital realized that a comprehensive digital transformation was the only way forward. To solve multiple pain points—manual documentation, missed appointments, and fragmented coordination; Lilavati hospital have decided on Healthray because it is a unified, AI-driven hospital management platform. Healthray's EHR module has drastically reduced the documentation time of doctors, which makes the consultation faster and more efficient. The Healthray web-based or cloud-supported system has eliminated the offline dependency of Lilavati hospital. The Healthray ABDM-compliant and interoperable system has modernized the workflows of Lilavati hospitals and elevated both patient experience and operational efficiency in the system.
text_block_2_text: Healthray has automated all the manual processes of Lilavati hospitals that were creating hindrances in their growth and care quality. Doctors were spending considerable time on manual documentation, which lengthens the consultation time and slows down patient flow in the system. The Healthray electronic health record system has resolved all the challenges of doctors.The entire workflow from ePrescriptions to instant access of patient medical history has become digital. Additionally, since the operation was offline prior to Healthray adoption, Healthray has solved the issue of patient outreach. The Healthray cloud-based system has filled this gap, enabling online appointments, teleconsultations, and automated reminders. Patients can now access their reports and prescriptions remotely.
text_block_3_text: After adopting Healthcare cloud and mobile-connected infrastructure, Lilavati Hospital has improved patient communication and accessibility. With Healthray, Lilavati Hospital can manage appointment reminders and follow-ups through automated digital reminders where patients get instant notifications, lab results and ePrescriptions directly through the patient portal, eliminating the need for multiple visits and lengthy coordination. Doctors can review patient histories outside the premises, ensuring continuous and personalized care.This improved accessibility has expanded the patient reach outside the city. Thus, teleconsultations or remote follow-ups are now readily accessible. Healthray has successfully resolved all the challenges, and they got measurable results: 30% faster consultations with AI suggestions and auto-fill, expanded telemedicine coverage throughout India, 70% EHR adoption within just 3 months and 40% fewer no-shows through automated reminders.According to the administrator, "Digital connectivity with HealthRay has made the patient experience seamless; now communication is fast and patient care is more accessible."
text_block_4_text: The Healthray interoperable system has integrated all the different departments of Lilavati Hospital into a single, unified, connected network. With Healthray, the pharmacy department can easily view digital prescriptions from doctors. Lab technicians can automatically receive test order notifications.Once lab results get ready, they directly get uploaded into the patient record. Thus, enabling doctors and patients to access their patient data in real time. This seamless integration has replaced the manual communication and paperwork, fostering both transparency and speed in the department. All team members now work in a coordinated flow, ensuring faster decision-making and better patient outcomes.After implementation of Healthray, Lilavati Hospital discovered tangible positive effects: Cross-department collaboration became effortless, manual errors and delays were drastically reduced, and real-time data sharing improved care accuracy.Doctors say, “With HealthRay, all departments work in the same digital rhythm; both care delivery and coordination become smooth.” ...
text_block_5_text: The Healthray transition has started at Lilavati Hospital with a well-organized implementation plan. Healthray specialists performed detailed assessments of all department workflows to deeply understand their existing challenges and design digital modules based on that.Hospital legacy data got securely migrated to the Healthray cloud system, ensuring a smooth transition without any data loss. Plus, the Healthray training team has organized on-site or virtual workshops to help doctors, nurses and front-desk staff to proficiently use the digital tools. The entire process has created a smooth and efficient digital adoption. Staff can now confidently operate the modules, whether it's billing, appointment management, or patient history tracking.Hospital administration says,
quote_text: “Healthray training has strengthened the confidence of every staff member. We can now manage all the departments in just one click.”
result_title: Tangible Outcomes: Savings, Growth, and Satisfaction
result_text:
After adopting Healthray cloud infrastructure, Lilavati Hospital has witnessed remarkable improvements in operational and financial performance. Lilavati has lessened additional expenses on server maintenance or IT staffing. There is a noticeable improvement in administrative efficiency. Staff overtime has significantly decreased, appointment adherence has increased dramatically, and the billing process takes less time to complete.

Doctors appreciate faster access to health records and streamlined workflows during consultations. Patients are equally satisfied with transparent billing, faster results, and the ability to access prescriptions online anytime. Healthray has created a smarter and patient-centric environment where technology and care maintain balance.A senior consultant remarked, “Healthray has revolutionized the way we practice. Every department speaks the same digital language now—it’s faster, smarter, and far more patient-friendly.”

challenge_text:
Universal hospital is a leading multi-specialty hospital in Surat that works with complex patient needs and multiple departments. With a manual and fragmented system, it was difficult for universal hospitals to manage patient data and administrative tasks. Delayed ,errors and workflow bottlenecks were impacting patient experience and efficiency.

Early on, hospital leadership understood that implementing cutting-edge healthcare technology is the only way to provide high-quality care and smooth interdepartmental coordination. text_block_0_text: Universal hospital is a leading multi-specialty hospital in Surat that works with complex patient needs and multiple departments. With a manual and fragmented system, it was difficult for universal hospitals to manage patient data and administrative tasks. Delayed ,errors and workflow bottlenecks were impacting patient experience and efficiency.
text_block_1_text: Having observed the challenges of paper-based and fragmented digital processes, universal hospitals was clear about one thing: the future of medical practice should depend on a robust, integrated Electronic Health Record (EHR) or practice management system. After evaluating multiple solutions in the market, Heathray software served as the best fit. Healthray is an easy-to-use web-based platform that offers extensive lab ordering, ePrescription, and billing features designed to meet hospital-scale requirements.
text_block_2_text: The rollout of healthray began six months prior to hospital scaling operations. Universal hospitals closely communicated with the Healthray implementation team to customize the workflow with hospital-unique practices. Despite a challenging schedule, the Healthray team delivered a smooth installation and uninterrupted integration process. To prepare the staff for transition, the Healthray team conducted extensive training sessions both virtually and on-site. Every department member—clinicians, nurses, administrative staff and billing specialists—got hands-on training to efficiently use the functionalities in their daily operations, encouraging a cooperative and knowledgeable workforce.
text_block_3_text: Healthray has helped universal hospitals in surgical treatments by providing a comprehensive digital platform that simplifies the entire surgical hospital. Doctors can easily access patient histories, lab results and imaging reports, which makes the preoperative assessment more accurate.Healthray software optimized surgery scheduling and resource management to ensure smooth communication among the surgical team. During surgeries, doctors get real-time data access to make tangible decisions. In the post-surgery phase, Healthray software tracks patient recovery, manages medications, and helps doctors manage follow-up schedules.
text_block_4_text: For universal hospitals, healthray impacts were not just limited to technologies. Healthray transforms their daily healthcare experiences. As one of the universal hospital doctors explained, “Previously we spent considerable time on paperwork, which reduced patient interaction. Now all our workflows are digitally organized; now we get reports, billing, and records on the single screen.” Healthray has incredibly reduced hospital operation expenses.Universal Hospitals got relief from manual record keeping and paper storage charges and staff overtime has been reduced. With Healthray software, physicians are no longer dependent on bulky charts; now tablets and laptops have become their new diagnostic tool.Doctor says, “Technology has become our medical tool, just like a stethoscope. We are now closer to our patients thanks to Healthray; we can now access all the information we need and concentrate on a strategic plan that improves patient care.”
text_block_5_text: One impactful and interesting development was that healthray enabled Universal Hospitals to integrate teleconsultation and remote monitoring capabilities into surgical care pathways. This makes the surgical pathways more advanced. Now, surgeons can conduct preoperative evaluations and postoperative follow-ups virtually.This drastically reduced the patient waiting time and travel time. Most importantly, rural patients can now directly connect with the specialist. This integration has helped universal hospitals increases surgical care access, improve recovery tracking, and minimize complications through timely intervention. The Heathray unified platform has created an ecosystem for Universal hospitals, where distance is no longer a bottleneck for patient care.
text_block_6_text: Healthray has empowered Universal hospitals with real-time analytics and advanced dashboards where clinical, operational and financial data are consolidated on a single platform. The leadership team is now able to track patient outcomes, optimize resources, and pinpoint new areas for improvement. This data-driven approach helps universal hospitals to make smarter and tangible decisions. Healthray software enhanced care quality, improved operational efficacy and raised the patient satisfaction level.

hero_list_0_text: Universal hospitals needed a fully integrated, innovative Electronic Health Record to manage clinical and administrative workflows
hero_list_1_text: Healthray offers extensive lab ordering, ePrescription, and billing features designed to meet hospital-scale requirements
hero_list_2_text: Result: Aids in Surgical Treatments,Revenue Growth, Cost saving and care enhancement
metrics_text: Key challenges Universal Hospitals face before implementing Healthray
challanges_0_text: University hospitals struggled with bulky paperwork, fragmented workflows, and slow manual documentation. This issue significantly reduces staff productivity, results in record loss, and wastes doctors' time on administrative tasks
challanges_1_text: Every department was using different software, resulting in scattered data and disconnected workflows. This caused duplicate entries, delayed updates, and poor visibility into patient history
challanges_2_text: Universal hospitals track OT schedules, pre-op approvals, and post-op updates manually. This fragmented process causes surgical delays, makes team communication weak and lowers the OT utilization
challanges_3_text: Teleconsultation tools and remote patient monitoring systems were not available. This complicates the follow-up process; rural patients did not have access, and continuity of care was disrupted
solutions_0_text: Healthray has helped universal hospitals in surgical treatments by providing a comprehensive digital platform that simplifies the entire surgical hospital. Doctors can easily access patient histories, lab results and imaging reports, which makes the preoperative assessment more accurate.
solutions_1_text: Healthray has incredibly reduced hospital operation expenses. Universal Hospitals got relief from manual record keeping and paper storage charges, and staff overtime has been reduced. With Healthray software, physicians are no longer dependent on bulky charts.
solutions_2_text: The adoption of digital record management and automated workflows has reduced the paper usage of hospitals from 2,000 pages per day to only 200 pages. This saves the cost of paper printing and storage expenses up to Rs 8 lakh per year.
solutions_3_text: The combination of optimized operations and accurate billing has delivered 10–15% revenue growth in the initial first year. Healthray's AI-driven billing automation and real-time error detection features have minimized claim denials and payment delays.
kpis_title: The Digital Journey of Universal Hospitals with Healthray
kpis_text: Universal hospitals closely communicated with the Healthray implementation team to customize the workflow with hospital-unique practices. The Healthray team has streamlined the entire operation, from patient intake to surgery scheduling, billing and management decisions
kpis_0_text: Digital forms and automated verification have made the onboarding process highly efficient. It makes patient entry easier for staff and removes manual errors.
kpis_1_text: Healthray automates repetitive tasks such as appointment scheduling, report sharing, and billing. It frees up staff time, allowing them to focus on patient care.
kpis_2_text: Doctors get unified medical records and AI-powered insights. It accelerated decision-making, improved diagnosis accuracy, and streamlined treatment planning, resulting in completely organized practices.
kpis_3_text: Real-time dashboards and automated reports help management make quick, confident, and accurate decisions Staff no longer rely on guesswork, resulting in increased clarity.
